text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back home from a trip out
with
Silence Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... Well...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Wow, would you look at all that water
in the
river. O-oh yeah...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of water... Are you feeling
thirsty?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh... I-is that so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's clearly something up with
Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: R-really?!
choice_data_list: C-Come to think of it, I might be getting thirsty...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I have some mineral water with me.
Would you
like some?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh... I forgot I finished it already.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry... Um, what to do...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'll go buy another one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She turns around, ready to dash off, but
I rush to
stop her.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Sorry... I got a little ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... I wanted to do something... to
make you
happy.
choice_data_list: You've been acting a little strange for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to show you my gratitude for
everything
you always do for me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she wants to make me happy, then...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Without any worries?
choice_data_list: I'd love it if you could just run freely.
I'd appreciate it if you were careful not to run too much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I understand. If that would make
you
happy, then...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'll get right to it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This time, I'm not able to stop her. She
runs off
ahead and fades out of sight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I continue walking by myself until I see
her
running back toward me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The sunset down by the river is
so
beautiful! You should—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wait... This isn't any different from our
usual
training...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You didn't?! But I was certain you—I'm
sorry!
choice_data_list: I didn't mean running right this second, though...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll take some time and think of a proper
way to
show you my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But, um... The scenery I mentioned really
was
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I go on ahead and run
home?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka turns around once again
and runs
off into the distance,
worry-free.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: U-um, I...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I understand. I'll make sure to be careful.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Don't run too much. Don't run too
much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wait a moment... How much is too
much? How
many hours, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank goodness. I wasn't sure what
you
meant...
choice_data_list: You don't have to push yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll run as much as I can without pushing
myself
too hard. Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
On that note, I'm going to run along the
river—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Wait. What did we decide I should do to
show
you my gratitude?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looks like we'll have to put a pin in it.
